hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. Swaps are handled entirely in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta — input tokens are deposited into and output tokens withdrawn from Euler lending vaults, while enforcing a custom invariant curve. Standard concentrated liquidity is blocked; the hook is deployed per-pool as an immutable delegatecall proxy.
